program: HIV treatment support, prevention, coverage access and harm reduction
priceScope: Full FY2025 recipient annual cost against a partial PrEP navigation mechanism; other channels unknown, not whole-portfolio or next-gift EV.
formula: Clinical patients N × navigation additionality × eligibility × adherence × biological efficacy × annual infection risk times finite HIV utility burden; subtract full participant harm. Household resources require prevented infection and jointly log net illness-related gains minus full navigation costs. Price =10C/(health + signed resource equivalents).
what: CHN supports Coloradans living with or at risk of HIV through treatment access, prevention and social support.
The matched FY2025 reference uses 557 PrEP navigations, not the sum of tests or all statewide clients.
Clinical patients and resource households are distinct; other channels remain unquantified.
strengths: Matched fiscal 2025 native navigation envelope and original full annual cost.
An original randomized PrEP trial anchors the prevention mechanism, not recipient attribution.
Public alternatives, household costs and external medication-resource incidence are explicit.
reservations: Navigation is not verified adherence or unique successful prevention.
Clinical utility, risk, additionality and Denver share are judgments.
Whole recipient costs cover substantial HIV care, nutrition and harm reduction outside this partial reference.

sections.what: Current statewide HIV client services, dental and mental health care, insurance assistance, nutrition, harm reduction and sexual-health prevention are not independent additive cohorts. HeyDenver and Hey719 report 557 PrEP navigations in FY2025; Colorado Springs is outside the Denver CBSA.
sections.monitoring: Request deduplicated PrEP starts, adherence and persistence, baseline infection risk, alternative provider access, residence, participant costs and restricted marginal capacity. Track HIV treatment continuity and overdose outcomes separately; reported reversals are not automatically deaths averted.
sections.qualitative: IPERGAY randomized high-risk MSM to on-demand medication or placebo with common counseling/testing: 2 versus 14 infections and 86% relative reduction over median 9.3 months. CHN serves different populations and navigation is a different intervention. Eligibility .8, adherence .6 and navigation additionality .2 remain hypotheses. Medication gastrointestinal and renal adverse events were more common; privacy and access harm are unmeasured.
sections.cost: FY2025 full cost $36,416,135 includes $99,264 netted direct event costs. The 557 navigation envelope is observed, not a causal patient count. Untreated infection risk .02 per year and utility decrement .2 for ten finite years are judgments: q=.004 is risk times annual illness burden, biological efficacy .86 applied once, not ten repeated years of infection risk. Judged Denver share .6 and household grouping .9 affect geography and income respectively; health retains all patients. Prevented-infection households gain $1,000 net work resources plus $200 otherwise-paid illness costs after tax, benefit and work-cost netting, with .5 positive overlap; no lifetime wages or retail medication value. Every navigation household retains $5 access/time costs even if prevention fails. Process/privacy harm .00002 per navigator is judged. Public medication delivery resources are unknown centrally and tested at $500 per eligible completed household, independent of navigation additionality. The $3,905,246 mixed education/prevention program-cost sensitivity is not allocated PrEP cost or marginal-gift efficiency.
sections.funding: Current own giving page identifies Colorado Health Network Inc., EIN 84-0961159, and region-designated support. No transaction was made. Federal prevention funding uncertainty can affect delivery but is not evidence every donation creates otherwise absent PrEP. Existing public clinics, insurance and medication assistance are counterfactual providers.

costScope: Full September-ending FY2025 recipient expense plus netted direct event cost; partial prevention benefits only.
geography: Judged .6 Denver ten-county CBSA19740 share of combined HeyDenver/Hey719 navigation. Clinic location and statewide headquarters do not establish client residence.
counterfactual: Public PrEP clinics, insurance and medication assistance, and other providers without CHN navigation.
attribution: Judged .2 navigation additionality, .8 eligibility, .6 adherence; .86 biological efficacy borrowed conditionally from high-risk on-demand trial, not measured navigation efficacy.
uncertainty: Risk, utility burden, adherence, residence, unique people, household costs, actual public alternatives and next-gift capacity unknown. Other recipient channels unknown, not zero.
native: Official February 2026 statement reports FY2025 557 PrEP navigations and separate test counts; neither completed medication nor causal clinical outcomes.

inputRationales.C: Observed original FY2025 full annual $36,316,871 plus netted direct event $99,264.
inputRationales.N: Observed FY2025 557 PrEP navigation clients; uniqueness and adherence not verified.
inputRationales.unique: Judged .9 client-to-resource-household grouping; does not reduce distinct clinical patients.
inputRationales.q: Judged .02 one-year infection risk times .2 annual HIV utility decrement; ten-year finite sequela stream, not measured QALYs.
inputRationales.response: Conditional .86 biological efficacy from original high-risk IPERGAY trial; not navigation effectiveness.
inputRationales.success: Judged .02 untreated annual infection risk; resource event probability also multiplies efficacy once.
inputRationales.workGain: Judged $1,000 first-year after-tax/benefit/work-cost illness-related resources per prevented infection; no full lifetime wages.
inputRationales.medicalGain: Judged $200 otherwise-paid illness expenses, not ART retail value.
inputRationales.delay: Judged .1-year navigation/engagement start for full access costs and resources.
